summary: Bump the release version to 0.1.9 and move changes made after the published 0.1.8 release (pool-wide NFS/SMB/clustered iSCSI storage, related fixes and BUG-0173 to BUG-0175) under its release notes. API impact: none; release metadata only.

guide.reason: Release version and notes only; operator workflows are unchanged.

api.reason: Builds consume the existing changelog version resolver; no client-facing API, Controller operation, Core command or observed-state contract changes.

state.reason: Release metadata does not create runtime state.

verification.method: release-version.py --current resolves 0.1.9; release-version unit tests, docs gate and privacy test pass. The 0.1.8 section keeps exactly the entries published from commit b0fa760. No build, tag or publish performed.
